named_source_anchors.needle: public abstract class CapabilityRelayBlockEntity extends BlockEntity
matching_lines: public abstract class CapabilityRelayBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

comment_corrections: /** GT6 seeds every logistics tile in the 5x5x5 cube, then traverses mutual open sides. */
/** Seed loaded physical hosts in the core cube, then cross mutual open sides without delegate lookup. */
/** Shared face storage. Cover configuration lives in the installed ItemStack NBT. */
/** Shared face storage; installed stack data holds filters, priority and target quantity. */
/** State is held by the six block-state connections; no inventory or server ticker is needed. */
/** Connections live in block state; installed covers are persisted and synchronized separately. */

readability.limit: Whitespace, explicit local renames and listed evidence-backed comment corrections only. No gameplay changes.

finite_source_witnesses.kind: Finite source-derived state/dispatch traces; no target code, handlers, world, saved-world restart or fault injection executed.

detached_sample.limit: Crowbar detach only. Old priority/quota lived in CoverData values, not in returned sample NBT; no claim they survived old detach.

universal_delegate.limit: Valid connected source graph without another path or seed for B; no claim physical placement was tested, or ordinary item/fluid capability relay is absent.

external_handler_throws.condition: Formed, powered core routes a legal item pair whose source handler getSlots throws RuntimeException.
external_handler_throws.original: GT_API_Proxy catches Throwable for this callback, removes it from SERVER_TICK_PRE, sets error and continues the list.
external_handler_throws.current: No core/router catch; native ticking catches Throwable and constructs ReportedException.
external_handler_throws.native_option_true: Sets removed and removes the block entity from the chunk; does not promise preserving its content or ordinary block removal.
external_handler_throws.limit: Conditional external provider failure; not a claim normal builtin routes crash, and not an instruction to enable native removal.

tie_order.original: HashSetNoNulls default HashMap keySet iteration over tile-entity identities; no insertion/coordinate order promised by the source.
tie_order.current: LinkedHashSet position insertion, x/y/z seed loop and FIFO discovery; endpoint lists preserve network iteration.
tie_order.policy: Retain modern stable physical ordering; do not invent a specific old first winner or require identity-hash order.

chunk_and_clock_scope.old_global_gate: SERVER_TIME reset at server start; SYNC_SECOND before increment; ServerTick START callback.
chunk_and_clock_scope.current_gate: Level.getGameTime % 20 at native block-entity ticker; native ServerLevel ticks time before block entities.
chunk_and_clock_scope.limit: Do not call the entire old graph forcibly chunk-loading, all dimensions asynchronous, or claim a measured phase/TPS effect. Full world phase acceptance remains open.

save_sync_exclusions: Wire save/load explicitly delegates covers and uses update tag/packet. Neo default onDataPacket/handleUpdateTag calls loadWithComponents.
Configured ComponentCoverHostMixin also calls fallback read/write; fallback read handles logistics covers even before its ordinary component-host gate.
Native saveWithoutMetadata creates a fresh CompoundTag. Missing empty-face key deletion in save alone does not prove stale normal saves.
CoverDropMixin captures attached cover data at final loot boundary; crowbar sample loss is not generalized to all harvest drops.
Unbind/removal clears core position snapshot and bindings. No new strong-reference unload-leak claim is made.

limits: No Java compilation, target initialization, Gradle, tests, game, build or push.
No full logistics acceptance or project completion. Actual client rendering, world scheduling/restart and external-provider behavior remain open.
Preserved policies and source differences are not equivalent to unfixed bug counts.
previous_goal_turn: Progress: committed 54d8cde85 with actual transport findings, full-source readability proofs and durable project state.

root_revalidation.kind: Named source/entry identities; complete selected execution streams after only declared local renames; raw literal positions, comments/directives, protected user files and added documentation.
